name: Shinohara Ryouta
source:
1st year high school student.
He's usually reading a book and only opening his mouth to say something sarcastic.
He doesn't like to get close to people on his own, but he also isn't good at rejecting people.
[url=/c29865]Sawanoi[/url] says it's because he's 'shy'.
